cards.title: Why Close Eyes When You Sneeze?
cards.body: Test your knowledge with five multiple-choice questions set by children. Submit your own junior brainteasers for future quizzes.

cards.title: Kindness of Strangers on Family Flights
cards.body: A passenger's small gesture—tucking a blanket around a sleeping child—transformed a stressful international flight with four kids. These moments remind us of human compassion when traveling with children.

cards.title: Son Leaves Home: Complicated Joy
cards.body: Taking your child to university stirs complex emotions—exhilaration and loss mixed together. Parents experience both the joy of their child's independence and nostalgia for earlier stages.

cards.title: Family Mealtimes Create Connection
cards.body: Eating together gives parents and children time to pause, listen, and share stories. Mealtimes are vital for building family bonds and emotional connection.

cards.title: Location-Tracking Apps and Parental Anxiety
cards.body: Parents use tracking apps to monitor loved ones' movements, blurring the line between safety and surveillance. This technology reflects modern anxieties about keeping children safe.

cards.title: Should You Tell Children About Your Will?
cards.body: Revealing inheritance plans to children early can prevent family conflict later. Unexpected surprises in wills have been known to tear families apart.

cards.title: How Teens Respond to Insecurity
cards.body: Adolescents often follow the herd when dealing with insecurity instead of forging their own path. Becoming confident means climbing your own mountain, not following others.

cards.title: Stop Checking Up on Adult Children
cards.body: Parents use social media and tracking apps excessively when children move away to university. Stepping back allows young adults to develop independence and manage their own lives.

cards.title: Prince Harry: Kids Happy in British School
cards.body: Prince Harry says his children are thriving in UK schools after six years in the US. The family relocated for 'lots of reasons' beyond just education.

cards.title: New ADHD Medications Explained for Parents
cards.body: Four new ADHD medication options have become available in the past five years. A psychiatrist explains each option and why most patients shouldn't constantly switch medications.
